topic: Data aggregation for network name changes
summary_markdown: A discussion occurred regarding data discrepancies related to a cluster's name and historical network names. It was confirmed that the master facility name can be changed. Regarding previous operational issues with the network registry and an additional temporary network period, it was determined that simply reaggregating the data for that specific time frame should resolve the issue.
decisions: Reaggregating data for the specified time period is sufficient to correct the historical record.
